name: upsample
expr: u0 = upsample(1:3, 3); u1 = upsample(1:3, 3, 1); u2 = upsample(1:3, 3, 2);
comment: Sig y=upsample(x,n[,phase]). Places samples at offset phase: y[phase + i*n] = x[i] (phase 0..n-1). upsample(1:3,3) -> [1 0 0 2 0 0 3 0 0]; phase 1 -> [0 1 0 0 2 0 0 3 0]; phase 2 -> [0 0 1 0 0 2 0 0 3]. numkit previously IGNORED phase -- now honored. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
